#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

const int MAXM = 1 << 20;

int n, k;
double prob[200];
double dp[MAXM];
double sumv[MAXM];
double ans[22];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> k;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> prob[i];

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        double s = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            if (mask & (1 << i)) s += prob[i];
        sumv[mask] = s;
    }

    dp[0] = 1.0;
    int flag = 0;

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        int qb = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        if (qb > k) continue;
        if (dp[mask] < 1e-100) continue;
        if (qb == k) flag = 1;
        double rem_sum = 1.0 - sumv[mask];
        if (rem_sum < 1e-6) continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) continue;
            double chance_move = dp[mask] * prob[i] / rem_sum;
            dp[mask | (1 << i)] += chance_move;
        }
    }

    if (!flag) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            ans[i] = (prob[i] < 1e-6) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
    } else {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == k) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    if (mask & (1 << i)) ans[i] += dp[mask];
            }
        }
    }

    cout.precision(12);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) cout << ' ';
        cout << fixed << ans[i];
    }
    cout << '\n';
    return 0;
}
